content: For individuals with type 2 diabetes who are able to achieve and maintain a weight loss of 10% or more, the benefits are particularly significant. This level of weight reduction is strongly associated with marked improvements in cardiovascular risk factors, including reductions in blood pressure and enhancements in lipid profiles. Additionally, such weight loss may decrease the risk of long-term complications related to type 2 diabetes, such as cardiovascular disease. It can also lead to improvements in overall quality of life and physical functioning. These findings highlight the importance of establishing realistic and achievable weight loss goals as an integral component of diabetes management.
